query:
SELECT 
  bs.id,
  bs.title,
  bs.source_type,
  COUNT(bel.id) as nb_liaisons
FROM bibliography_sources bs
LEFT JOIN bibliography_entity_links bel ON bel.bibliography_id = bs.id
WHERE bs.id >= 30001
GROUP BY bs.id, bs.title, bs.source_type
ORDER BY bs.id;
